reshade.scope: D3D12 metadata/interception, minimal DXGI forwarding; no effects/UI/OpenXR/external add-ons

local_adaptations: Independent upscaler-driven settings/maintenance ticks; desktop and VR rendering
Guarded enable epochs and private-adapter passthrough
Independent names, reversible installer; no OpenXR registration or OFXR/AutoFPS helpers
Live glass/advanced/experimental options and transient green tint; author defaults and resets
Preserve native upscaler output until a newly accepted display has current glass residuals
Monotonic expiry for extra-pass selection and desktop map reuse in the upscaler-driven host
Direct updates preserve the whole settings file and original uninstall backups; rollback/recovery journal
